concept.title: Levels of decision — Rescinding a Claim Procedure disentitlement (D15)

conbody.p: If the client does not respond to the requests to provide missing information, it is considered as a failure to report for an interview. The National Policy on Levels of Decision specifies that a Level 1 officer rescinds a D15 when the requested information is provided within 6 weeks of the date the D-01-00-00 letter was sent. For more information, the Level 1 officer refers to Reviewing a D15 disentitlement — Failure to report for a telephone interview .
